UUID Generator

Bulk RFC-4122 version-4 UUIDs.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose how many UUIDs to generate (1 to 500).
  2. Optionally tick uppercase and/or braces formatting.
  3. Click Generate UUIDs.
  4. Copy them all at once or download them as a .txt file.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Are these UUIDs really unique?

A version-4 UUID has 128 random bits, so collisions are practically impossible — you could generate billions per second for years without a repeat.

Are the UUIDs cryptographically random?

Yes. They use your browser's cryptographic random number generator (crypto.getRandomValues), not Math.random.

Why do the UUIDs always contain a 4 in the same spot?

The 13th hex digit is always 4 (the version) and the 17th is 8, 9, a or b (the variant) — that is what makes it a valid version-4 UUID.
